{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Investment in the nation's public health infrastructure is critical to ensuring preparedness for emerging threats, preventing disease, illness, and injury in communities, and promoting good health and wellbeing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Inadequate access to public health services has a disparate impact on poor, rural, and minority communities where public health services are a significant source of health care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for increased investments in public health to better address emerging threats and the needs across the country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will continue to oppose Republican attempts to cut public health services and funding.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Adequate funding of public health education at the undergraduate, graduate, and medical school levels will be ensured.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Adequate funding of residency training programs in public health, preventive medicine, and its subspecialties will be ensured.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
